author: sgodoy17
quote: This was my first 3D game; I was a kid when my late father gave it to me. The most cherished memories I have from that era about this game are irreplaceable; to me, along with *Final Fantasy VII*, they are true masterpieces of video games.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: sgodoy17
quote: What can I say that hasn't already been said? To me, this is a masterpiece; I've put in about 900 hours of gameplay, I have every item in the game, I've tried lots of different settings, and I'm still playing.

author: sgodoy17
quote: I know it might be a little late, but I played this game when it came out and really enjoyed it; I had a great time and ended up completing it 100%.

author: sgodoy17
quote: Dude, I play video games to escape reality, to blow off steam—why do I have to waste my time putting up with my girlfriend's toxic behavior? That's like four hours of gameplay! What the hell, man!

author: sgodoy17
quote: This is what I asked for, a one one remake with better engine, no woke no dei, the game is awesome, thanks for giving us what we wanted
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
